question: Which deeds identifying Hanumān as Rudra's incarnation are to be spoken in the mantra?
premises: Hanumān is called an incarnation of Rudra
The burning of the city of Laṅkā is referenced
These words are to be spoken
inference: One should say the words identifying Hanumān as Rudra's incarnation and burner of the city of Laṅkā.
plain_english: One should say 'incarnation of Rudra, burner of the city of Laṅkā'.
